hana: Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A  need one clean timeline + owners for API / Console / Optimize we can share externally. Short replies please.
oscar: Product short: API hosted GA public 2026-10-14 (internal 2026-09-30). Console revamp GA 2026-11-26. Optimize early beta 2026-07-20. Owners: oscar (API), rae (Console docs/flows), matt (Optimize infra).
matt: Runtime note: Optimize beta requires batching refactor + KV cache stability. Batching PR targets canary 2026-06-29; KV cache fixes in prod-canary 2026-06-22. Perf sweep scheduled 2026-07-07.
rae: DevEx ask: we need a Console admin quickstart + 2 sample apps + migration checklist. I can deliver a sample repo stub by 2026-06-30, drafts of guides by 2026-07-18. Need runtime review for samples.
claire: Leadership: make API streaming + tools the priority for hosted GA. Console visual polish can be deferred to post-GA; focus Console GA on admin/rollout APIs and dashboards so we don't block API.
ben: Sales: asking for a one-page "customer-facing bullets" + short FAQ on Dedicated behavior/pilot. Need draft by 2026-07-19 to prep outreach.
oscar: Scope confirmation: API GA = streaming, function/tool calls, quotas/rate-limits, basic metrics export; Console GA = route & model dashboards, rollout/canary UI, admin RBAC; Optimize beta = batching suggestions + quantization hints (no auto-apply).
matt: For Dedicated tenants: autoscale changes will be piloted in August with 3 pilot customers; I'll post pilot invites + compatibility notes by 2026-07-04.
rae: Docs/devex freeze: two weeks before each public GA. I'll coordinate a review slot with runtime on 2026-09-14 for API docs.
allhands-bot: Created task #12134 "AH: publish timeline + owners for API/Console/Optimize" and assigned to oscar, matt, rae. Due 2026-06-24.
hana: Can engineering confirm go/no-go for API public GA by 2026-09-12 so marketing can schedule the public announcement?
matt: Tentative yes, but final after perf sweep on 2026-07-07 and canary runs in Sept. If regressions, will open blocker immediately and ping leadership.
oscar: I'll update the roadmap board once engineering posts canary/perf results. We'll push a short pre-brief to sales/CS immediately after confirmation.
ben: Sales will prepare the one-pager and post for review by 2026-07-19.
claire: One leadership ask: explicitly list which Console UX polish items are "nice-to-have" vs "must-have" in the scope doc so product can trim if needed. @oscar please add.
oscar: Will update the scope doc today and link it here.
rae: I'll share the sample repo link when the stub is up (aiming 6/30).
hana: Thanks all  scheduling a short sync Tuesday 10:30am PT to close outstanding blockers. Add any items to task #12134. :calendar:
